name: timeblock
description: A built-in task manager <-> Google Calendar time-blocking life manager

scripts.start: npm run build && npm -w @timeblock/server run start
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @timeblock/server run typecheck && npm -w @timeblock/web run typecheck
scripts.desktop:dev: npm -w @timeblock/server run build && npm -w @timeblock/desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm -w @timeblock/server run build && npm run workout:build && npm -w @timeblock/desktop run dist
